page-title-index: Speak2DB - Your AI Senior Data Consultant
description: The Senior Data Consultant your SME needs. Get decision-grade insights without the steep learning curve, expensive implementations, or the complexity of traditional data platforms.
f1-title: 🧠 Forget SQL, fragile formulas, filters, and manual work.
f1-desc: Speak2DB builds the queries for you — across databases and Excel files — and, if a query fails, automatically adjusts it without modifying your data. You get the right answer, clearly explained, with full technical details.
f2-summary-desc: High-level synthesis for quick decision-making. Strategic reports created in seconds, saving you hours of manual spreadsheet analysis.
f2-data-desc: Detection of errors and record anomalies.
f2-integrity-desc: We don't just generate charts and KPIs; we audit them. Professional validation of visual and data integrity to ensure your insights are never misleading.
f3-desc: Stay ahead of issues. Get automatic email notifications about future stock-outs or sales anomalies.
f4-desc: Zero-friction monitoring. Instead of fighting with complex design canvases, get straight to the point. Select your key queries, pick a professional template, and build a high-impact dashboard instantly accessible from any location and any device.
f5-desc: Connect effortlessly to MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or simply add your Excel files.
f6-desc: Store and compare historical reports to understand your business evolution month by month.
f7-desc: Secure architecture with zero write permissions. Your original data is never at risk of modification.
f8-desc: Export results to Excel or CSV with one click, including professional charts ready to share.
